title: ManifoldCache: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Constraint Manifold Caching
abstract: arXiv:2610.04510v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. translated_title: ManifoldCache：基于约束流形缓存的无训练扩散模型加速方法
translated_abstract: 面向结构化科学生成的扩散模型必须产生满足物理、化学或生物学所施加的严格几何约束的样本，然而在这类场景下推理速度极其缓慢，每个样本需要数百到数千次神经函数评估。我们在一个统一的抽象框架——约束流形扩散模型——之下，统一了八个涵盖医学体数据、分子构象、蛋白质骨架设计、晶体结构预测以及多视角3D场景的最新模型；在该框架中，目标分布支撑在由外部指定的约束映射所定义的流形上。所有现有的加速方法家族在这一类模型上都会失效：量化会在高维体数据算子上耗尽内存；剪枝会破坏约束保真度；快速ODE求解器会使轨迹偏离约束流形；而特征缓存启发式方法则对约束几何视而不见……
tldr: 提出ManifoldCache，一种无需训练的扩散模型加速方法，通过约束流形缓存克服了量化、剪枝、快速ODE求解器和特征缓存等现有加速技术在约束流形扩散模型（CMDMs）上全部失效的问题，可显著减少医学体数据、分子构象、蛋白质设计、晶体预测和3D场景等科学生成任务中昂贵的神经函数评估次数。
en_tdlr: ManifoldCache is a training-free diffusion acceleration method that leverages constraint manifold caching to overcome the failure of existing acceleration techniques (quantization, pruning, fast ODE solvers, and feature caching) on Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models across structured scientific generation tasks.
